outline.unique_angle: Every top-3 result treats this as either an SEO-attribution question or an AI-disclosure-compliance question. None frame brand neutrality as a single, blog-wide reader-trust budget that a personal-essay author spends the instant a post reads like marketing. The article's concrete hook — actually counting brand mentions across posts, pages, queue, AND the agent contracts running the publishing pipeline, then doing one replace pass — is a builder's-eye angle no competitor has.
